recognize_zh: CD5免疫染色下，塞滿固有層的中型浸潤細胞幾乎全部陰性（藍色），只有散在的小型反應性T細胞呈棕色陽性；腺體上皮的膜狀著色屬非特異性背景。「CD3陽性但CD5陰性」支持NK細胞表型，符合NK細胞腸病。
features: Dense lamina propria infiltrate of medium-sized cells that is CD5-negative
Scattered small CD5-positive reactive T cells within the lamina propria serving as internal control
Glandular epithelium shows membranous brown staining, interpreted as nonspecific background rather than lymphoid positivity
Glands preserved and separated by the negative infiltrate; no epitheliotropism by positive cells
describe_en: CD5 immunohistochemistry on gastrointestinal mucosa shows that the dense lamina propria infiltrate of medium-sized cells is negative, with only scattered small CD5-positive reactive T cells. Membranous staining of the glandular epithelium is nonspecific. Loss of CD5 in a CD2/CD3 (cytoplasmic)-positive infiltrate supports an NK-cell phenotype. Together with CD56 positivity and EBER negativity in a superficial non-destructive infiltrate, the findings are consistent with NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Indolent T-LPD usually retains CD5 on the neoplastic T cells, whereas the infiltrate here is CD5-negative.
MEITL is also typically CD5-negative, but it shows marked epitheliotropism, surface CD3/CD8 expression and clonal TCR rearrangement.
ENKTL is also CD5-negative; it is separated by EBER positivity and angiodestructive necrotic growth.
